description: The stage-3 gate set: fight starts from the full-run job's held-out shards (shard index % 5 == 0) of generations [3, 4], {1: 240, 2: 180, 6: 180} by node type, dealt as recorded (deck, upgrades, enchantments, relics, potions, HP, belt, floor) at the loop's ascension with a fresh seed from 5000. Frozen: never regenerate it for a running loop.
